title.zh-CN: 比特币迁移：分别要做什么？

subtitle.en: r8's BRUTER framework separates the proposed conditions, network activation and the funds left behind.
subtitle.zh-CN: r8 的 BRUTER 框架：方案条件、网络升级，以及未迁移资金。

en: r8 proposes bigger blocks to make room for migration transactions.
The need depends on the design.
zh-CN: r8 提出扩大区块，为迁移交易留出空间。
是否需要扩容，取决于具体方案。

en: r8 names Raqcoin as his example.
This note doesn't assess its implementation or establish it as Bitcoin's choice.
zh-CN: r8 点名 Raqcoin 作为示例。
本篇不鉴定其实现，也不表示比特币已选择它。

en: The network accepts and validates new spending rules.
Activation does not move every existing output.
zh-CN: 网络开始接受并验证新的花费规则。
规则激活不会替所有已有输出完成迁移。

en: In a holder-signed approach, funds move into outputs protected by the new rules.
Other designs can have different requirements.
zh-CN: 在需要持有人签名的方式下，资金转入受新规则保护的输出。
其他设计可能有不同要求。

en: What happens to funds that do not migrate?
r8 objects to forced freezing, destruction or abandonment.
zh-CN: 没有迁移的资金怎么办？
r8 反对强制冻结、销毁或遗弃。

en: Some funds can remain under the old rules after most holders migrate.
This is the final R added to BRUTE.
zh-CN: 多数持有人迁移之后，仍可能有资金留在旧规则下。
这是 BRUTE 后来增加的末尾 R。

note.en: These are parts of an argument. No Bitcoin activation or schedule is established by this diagram.
note.zh-CN: 这些部分组织的是作者的论述，并不表示比特币已采用这套方案或时间表。

alt.en: Six parts of r8's framework: proposed block space and signing scheme, network upgrade, holder migration, disputed forced treatment and residual funds. r8 opposes forced disposal.
alt.zh-CN: r8 框架的六个部分：区块空间和签名方案、网络升级、持有人迁移、强制处置争议与遗留资金。r8 反对强制处置。

subtitle.en: r8's overall scenario and a historical block-space model answer different questions.
subtitle.zh-CN: r8 的整体情景与历史区块容量模型，回答的是不同问题。

en: The start and duration are his assumptions. The addition does not establish either one.
zh-CN: 起点和工期是他的设定，加法本身不能证明这两个输入。

en: About 76 days
17,020 upgrades per block
10 minutes per block; round up to 10,969 whole blocks.
zh-CN: 约 76 天
每块处理 17,020 条
每块 10 分钟；向上取整为 10,969 块。

en: About 305 days
An idealized processing calculation using the June 2024 snapshot.
zh-CN: 约 305 天
使用 2024 年 6 月快照的理想化处理算例。

en: Unchanged block rules, ideal packing and omitted overhead.
Agreement, development, deployment and holder response are outside this calculation. It does not establish a 10–20 year migration.
zh-CN: 区块规则不变、极限打包，并忽略部分开销。
共识、开发、部署和持有人响应不在计算中，不能据此证明迁移需要 10—20 年。

note.en: UTXOs are unspent transaction outputs. Counting all outputs differs from protecting a chosen share of BTC value.
note.zh-CN: UTXO 是未花费的交易输出。按全部输出条数计算，与保护某一比例的 BTC 金额不同。

alt.en: r8's assumed 2030 start and 10–20 year duration are separate from an idealized June 2024 UTXO processing calculation: about 76 days at full capacity or 305 at 25%. The calculation excludes agreement, deployment and holder response.
alt.zh-CN: r8 假设的 2030 年起点和 10—20 年工期，与 2024 年 6 月 UTXO 容量算例分开呈现：全容量约 76 天，25% 容量约 305 天；不含共识、部署和持有人响应。

subtitle.en: A wallet can stay untouched for years while its owner still has the keys.
subtitle.zh-CN: 钱包多年没动，主人仍可能持有所需密钥。

en: Vulnerable funds may remain open to theft if attackers acquire the relevant quantum capability.
Exposure depends on the funds and attack conditions.
zh-CN: 在攻击者具备相应量子能力时，脆弱资金仍可能被盗。
风险取决于具体资金和攻击条件。

en: Making funds unspendable may also lock out owners who still control them.
r8 opposes forced disposal.
zh-CN: 让资金无法花费，也可能限制仍能控制资产的持有人。
r8 反对强制处置。

title.en: Inactivity does not establish lost keys
title.zh-CN: 长期未动，不能证明私钥已丢失

en: Early mining history, present control and migration status describe different things.
Some holders can sign but have not acted. Others lack the credentials needed for an ordinary migration.
zh-CN: 早期挖矿身份、现在能否控制、是否已经迁移，是不同问题。
有人仍能签名但尚未操作，也有人缺少普通迁移所需的凭据。

title.zh-CN: 多数资金迁移后，还剩什么问题？

en: The treatment of residual funds still needs a decision.
The May 2025 Milton/Shikhelman report separately examines this ownership dilemma.
zh-CN: 遗留资金的处置问题仍然存在。
Milton／Shikhelman 的 2025 年 5 月报告也独立讨论了这一权利困境。

note.en: Source agreement on an ownership dilemma does not imply agreement on every forecast or proposed mechanism.
note.zh-CN: 对权益困境的讨论有所重合，不代表来源之间认可全部预测或处置办法。

alt.en: Keeping old rules can leave vulnerable funds exposed under the stated quantum-attack condition. Restricting those rules can lock out owners who still control funds. Inactivity alone does not establish lost keys.
alt.zh-CN: 保留旧规则可能留下有条件的盗取风险；限制旧规则可能影响仍能控制资产的人。长期未动不能证明私钥已丢失。

title.zh-CN: 一份迁移提案需要说明什么？

subtitle.en: Follow the rules, the services and the holders through the proposed transition.
subtitle.zh-CN: 沿着规则、服务方和持有人的迁移过程逐项核对。

en: Which spending conditions change?
Which funds would the new rules protect?
Which funds would stay under old rules?
zh-CN: 改变哪些花费条件？
新规则保护哪些资金？
哪些资金仍留在旧规则下？

en: Has a proposal been accepted?
Have the new rules been activated?
Do wallets, exchanges and custodians support it?
zh-CN: 提案是否通过？
新规则是否激活？
钱包、交易所和托管方是否支持？

en: Who needs to sign or move funds?
How are holders notified?
What migration and recovery routes are available?
zh-CN: 谁需要签名或转移资金？
如何通知持有人？
有哪些迁移和恢复途径？

en: Is there a deadline?
Would spending rights change?
What evidence supports any proposed restriction?
zh-CN: 是否设定期限？
花费权利是否改变？
限制旧规则的依据是什么？

en: Nic Carter discusses the work beyond a software upgrade. His remarks aren't an endorsement of r8's dates or forecasts.
zh-CN: Nic Carter 也讨论了软件升级之外的迁移过程，这不代表他认可 r8 的日期或预测。

note.en: Use activation evidence, service support and completed migrations to track different parts of the proposal.
note.zh-CN: 规则激活、服务支持与资金实际迁移，需要分别核对。

alt.en: Questions for a migration proposal: spending conditions and protection scope, activation and service support, holder action and recovery, deadlines and the rights of funds left behind.
alt.zh-CN: 核对迁移提案的花费规则与保护范围、激活与服务支持、持有人操作及恢复途径、期限与遗留资金权利。
